'''''Dasha Sigweed''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to advertise a [[Dasha Sigweed/Legends|person]] of the same name on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The poster had a blue, white and greenish-blue [[Color/Legends|color]] palette and was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script.<ref name="Lethal" /> It could be found in such diverse places as a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum District G17]],<ref name="Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> in [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="Lethal" /> an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unnamed cantina]],<ref name="Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> and the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] in the [[79's/Legends|79's]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
